note: USACE Rock Island District campground on the east shore of Coralville Lake, north of Iowa City, in mixed-hardwood woods with several open lawn loops toward the lake. Register at the fee booth before setting up. The Sugar Bottom day-use area has the beach, boat ramp, fish cleaning station, 18-hole disc golf, the Sugar Bottom mountain bike trails and the Cedar Valley Nature Trail. Boats must come out of the water each night. --Claude

flags: STATUS: no construction closure is current. recreation.gov shows September 2026 nights held 'Reserved' on most sites (229 of 234 on Labor Day weekend), May 2027 open for booking, and no closure notice among the active notices. Status set to open and its note cleared. (When in 2026 it reopened isn't stated; the calendar no longer returns June.)

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (not waterfront -> lakeview): official recreation.gov photos show open lake views from sites 172, 174 and 176 (open lawn loop on the south point) and from 030, 047, 100 and 101 (west shore, the water past a brush fringe), 7 view candidates. None qualifies as on-water: on Esri imagery (0.31 m/px) the west-shore pads are ~50-90 m back behind a brush/reed band and an exposed drawdown strip (Coralville is a flood-control pool, so the shoreline moves a lot); the south loop's 178-181 face the paved shore walk, a fishing area and the boat-ramp parking lot (day use between), and their own photos face inland.
PIN ~420 m off: stored 41.76313,-91.56131 sits on the stormwater ponds by the entrance road, NE of the sites. The catalog's RV-site centroid is 41.7594,-91.5617.
